scope: Standard continuum geometry GI_GAUSS_1 through GI_GAUSS_5 rules; plane stress and plane strain share the 2D tables.
center_definition: Reference-element volume/area centroid mapped through the geometry, not the physical centroid of an arbitrary distorted element.
weight_definition: Raw weight stored by Kratos IntegrationPoint.Weight(), without Jacobian, thickness, or axisymmetric factor.
python_api_note: Element.GetIntegrationPoints() returns global coordinates in active-rule order. It does not return local coordinates or raw weights.

checks: Parsed point count matches C++ IntegrationPointsNumber()
Reference measures and first moments match each reference geometry
Pyramid measures include canonical collapsed-mapping determinant (1-zeta)^2/4
